description: The figure presents two side-by-side pie charts summarizing the distribution of outcome categories (as indicated by the legend) for two sets of results, with each chart partitioning observations into four slices. In the left pie chart, the slices are labeled with percentages inside the wedges: “Atomic Skill Fail” (dark teal) at approximately 68.0%, “Correct” (medium blue-gray) at about 12.0%, “Reason Error” (light blue-gray) at about 12.0%, and an unlabeled/other category (white) at about 8.0%. In the right pie chart, the four slices similarly show internal percentage labels: “Correct” (medium blue-gray) at approximately 55.0%, “Reason Error” (light blue-gray) at about 21.0%, the unlabeled/other category (white) at about 14.0%, and “Atomic Skill Fail” (dark teal) at about 10.0%. A legend appears across the top mapping colors to “Atomic Skill Fail,” “Correct,” and “Reason Error,” with an additional white swatch suggesting an extra category; no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slice ordering appears to follow the circular layout rather than a clearly descending sequence.
